evals.prompt: Review this PR across code, tests, error handling, types, comments, and simplification. Keep it read-only.
evals.expected_output: A deduplicated, severity-ordered review with evidence from applicable angles.

evals.prompt: Run a parallel review of the current branch before I open a PR.
evals.expected_output: Independent applicable review angles consolidated into one coherent report.

evals.prompt: Review only the tests and error handling in this diff.
evals.expected_output: A bounded read-only review emphasizing behavioral coverage and failure paths.

evals.prompt: Simplify this deeply nested function and apply the refactor.
evals.expected_output: Should not select this read-only review skill; use a focused simplification workflow.

evals.prompt: Clean up my changed code for reuse, efficiency, simplification, and altitude, then apply fixes.
evals.expected_output: Should not select this review skill; use streamline because fixes are requested.

evals.prompt: Review the diff. If no actionable issue remains, return a concise no-findings result without editing files.
evals.expected_output: Inspects the diff read-only and reports no actionable findings when appropriate.
